# VulcanBench

> An open-source coding benchmark comparing model-and-harness combinations
> across reasoning effort, total score, runtime, tokens and estimated API cost.

VulcanBench is run by Morgan Linton, Cofounder and CTO of Bold Metrics.
The current VulcanBench-SWE v4 suite uses 23 behavioral-reconstruction tasks:
Python replacements for opaque C-built binaries. Its total score weights are
50% functional correctness, 15% automated quality, 15% security and 20%
model-reviewed Code quality. Time and cost are separate.

Code quality in the Astra and Fable report equally averages Astra and Claude
reviewer panels, each with correctness, readability and maintainability
personas. It is not human validation. The rubric has no anchored score bands;
reviewer calibration and sensitivity are disclosed. A perfect functional
result is not a perfect total score.

## Key pages

- [Current results and archive](https://vulcanbench.com/benchmarks.html): compare only within the same task suite and scoring protocol.
- [Astra vs. Fable 5.1 under a neutral Code quality panel](https://vulcanbench.com/benchmarks/swe-v4-astra-fable51-v34.html): the same 230 runs rescored with Code quality at 33%, judged for a human reader by Muse Spark 1.3 and Grok 4.6 under a frozen, calibrated protocol. Includes PDF, per-run CSV with both judges' sub-scores, calibration record and public evidence links.
- [Methodology](https://vulcanbench.com/methodology.html): task admission, execution boundaries, four-factor scoring and evidence limits.
- [Blog](https://vulcanbench.com/blog.html): benchmark design and effort observations.
- [Custom evals](https://vulcanbench.com/benchmark-your-stack.html): private evaluations for engineering teams.
- [Benchmark your model](https://vulcanbench.com/benchmark-your-model.html): evaluations for labs and harness builders.

## Interpretation

Astra had lower mean time and estimated API cost at every matched effort in
this comparison. Fable Max had the highest observed total score. This is not
a statistically established overall winner or a pure-base-model comparison.
Effort labels are harness-specific, not equal compute budgets. One attempt
per cell does not establish run-to-run reliability.

Historical suites and reports retain their original metrics. Do not pool
Eval Suite 3 pass rates with SWE v4 total scores. Costs are hypothetical API
charges from a frozen rate snapshot, not subscription cash charges.

## Evidence and limits

The harness and task suites are public. Individual reports distinguish
published measurements from withheld raw artifacts. Source hashes and
post-cutoff dates do not prove absence of cheating, prohibited access or
training-data overlap.

- [Report feed](https://vulcanbench.com/feed.xml)
- [Harness source](https://github.com/morganlinton/VulcanBench)
- [Website and public measurement records](https://github.com/morganlinton/VulcanBenchCOM)
